segments.t: Timofey explains to Chef Barinov that he hid his past as a card sharp from Kostya, and demonstrates a card trick. Just then, Lyova reports that Mikhail is furious because his high-stakes poker game fell through.
Я скрыл, что сидел в тюрьме.
Вот мой сын на меня обиделся.
Там не было ничего совсем серьёзного.
Я ведь просто любил играть в карты.
Дал же мне бог такой талант.
Ничего страшного, вы скоро помиритесь.
Простите, шеф, там сейчас Михаил злится.
У него сегодня важный покер сорвался.
Он хотел играть с богатым иностранцем.
Я даже точно знаю, с каким.
Вот он теперь ходит и злится.
Кажется, я могу помирить вас с Костей.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Я скрыл, что сидел в тюрьме.
'I hid that I served time in prison.' Once he hid that he served time in prison, the guest can finally tell Barinov what he means.
Вот мой сын на меня обиделся.
'So my son got offended at me.' Adding that his son got offended at him fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
Там не было ничего совсем серьёзного.

'There was nothing really serious there.' The guest tells Barinov that there was nothing really serious there without dressing it up. Russian stacks "never" or "nothing" together with "not", doubling the refusal for extra weight.
Я ведь просто любил играть в карты.
'I simply loved playing cards.' Since he simply loved playing cards, the guest does not waste words on excuses.
Дал же мне бог такой талант.
'God gave me such a talent.' Mentioning that someone gave him such a talent moves the talk in a new direction.
Ничего страшного, вы скоро помиритесь.

'It is nothing terrible, you will make up soon.' Saying that it is nothing terrible the guest will make up soon is how Barinov sets the tone with the guest. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Простите, шеф, там сейчас Михаил злится.
'Excuse me, chef, Mikhail is raging over there right now.' Because Mikhail is raging over there right now, Lyova treats the matter as settled.
У него сегодня важный покер сорвался.
'His important poker game fell through today.' Explaining that his important poker game fell through today lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
Он хотел играть с богатым иностранцем.
'He wanted to play with a rich foreigner.' Saying that he wanted to play with a rich foreigner is how Lyova sets the tone with Barinov.
Я даже точно знаю, с каким.
'I even know exactly with which one.' Claiming that he even knows exactly with which one sounds confident, even if the guest has doubts.
Вот он теперь ходит и злится.
'So now he is walking around getting angry.' Pointing out that he is walking around getting angry gives Barinov a sobering reality check.
Кажется, я могу помирить вас с Костей.

'It seems I can reconcile you with Kostya.' Barinov mentions that it seems he can reconcile the guest with Kostya so the guest sees what is at stake.
